lina-sec: Quick proposal: reduce dev SIEM retention to 14d, keep prod 365d. We need a safe export workflow for investigations.
ben-ops: agree but need gated exports and an audit trail.
carla-sre: suggest export roles: export:request, export:approve, export:download. Only security and legal get approve/download.
omar-infra: can add IAM roles + require SSE-KMS on the evidence bucket. Will draft key policy.
jas-legal: legal requires Jira ticket, requestor/approver fields, and `legal_hold` boolean. Audit metadata kept 7 years.
carla-sre: require manifest + sha256 HMAC for every export; validator job rejects missing manifest. Small manifest example: {export_id:exp-2026-12-01-1,timestamp:2026-12-01T03:00:00Z,case_id:CASE-2026-999,retention_days:365,legal_hold:false,hmac:sha256:...}
ben-ops: gate via Jira + OPA rule: auto-approve if incident_id present and requester in security; otherwise security lead must approve. Deny retention>365 without exec signoff.
omar-infra: KMS rotation note: keep previous key versions and allow decrypt to export service principal. Add rewrap playbook.
lina-sec: action items: (1) IAM role PR (omar), (2) OPA + Jira automation (ben), (3) export template + validator (carla), (4) legal metadata schema (jas). Target: land before next billing cycle.
infra-bot: reminder: infra deploy window 2026-12-05 02:00-04:00 UTC.
